name: Deathstalker Lesh
summary: Deathstalker Lesh is a Forsaken rogue serving as a forward scout at Southpoint Tower in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Operating directly under High Executor Darthalia, she keeps watch over the human farms in the Hillsbrad Fields to gauge when the Forsaken should strike.

sections.title: Eyes on the Fields
sections.body: Perched at Southpoint Tower on the southern road through the Hillsbrad Foothills, Deathstalker Lesh monitors the human farmers and town militia working the nearby Hillsbrad Fields. As an operative of the Deathstalkers—the Forsaken's secretive intelligence and assassination network—Lesh tracks enemy movements and numbers for High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill. When the moment is right, Lesh sends word to Darthalia with a coded message, 'The raven's cry from the west doth beckon', signaling that Hillsbrad is ripe for the Forsaken's attack.

faq.answer: Lesh is a Forsaken scout stationed at Southpoint Tower. She answers to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill and monitors the human activity across the Hillsbrad Fields.

The Deathstalkers serve Queen Sylvanas Windrunner as scouts, spies, and assassins. They function as the covert arm of the Forsaken military, gathering intelligence and eliminating high-value targets across Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is Lesh's role at Southpoint Tower?
faq.answer: She acts as a forward lookout. From Southpoint Tower she surveys the town of Hillsbrad, and when the time is right she sends a traveler to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill with a coded message signaling that Hillsbrad is ripe for attack.
She reports to High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander stationed at Tarren Mill who oversees the offensive against the human forces in Hillsbrad.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, scouts like Lesh represent the vital frontier work of securing Lordaeron from Alliance resurgents.
Deathstalker Lesh demonstrates the essential military function of covert operatives within the Horde war effort.
